 FC Porto name XI for USC Paredes: Francesco Farioli makes eight changes 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article FC Porto have announced their starting XI for the home match against USC Paredes, scheduled for this Friday at 8:45 pm at the Estádio do Dragão. The Portuguese Cup fourth-round tie will be broadcast on RTP1.
 Francesco Farioli makes eight changes to the side that beat Vitória SC 2-1 in Guimarães. Cláudio Ramos, Martim Fernandes , Nehuén Pérez, Francisco Moura, Souza, Alan Varela , Seko Fofana and André Silva come in, while Diogo Costa, Alberto Costa, Jan Bednarek, Jakub Kiwior, Zaidu, Pablo Rosario, Victor Froholdt and Samu drop out of the starting XI.
 OneFootball Videos
 The Porto coach has selected: Cláudio Ramos (capt.); Martim Fernandes, Nehuén Pérez, Francisco Moura, Souza, Alan Varela, Seko Fofana, Gabri Veiga , Pepê, Borja Sainz and André Silva.
 Farioli will have João Costa, Jan Bednarek, Dominik Prpić, Zaidu, Pablo Rosario, Inbeom Hwang, Victor Froholdt, Oskar Pietuszewski and Santiago Gimenez available on the bench.
